name: マンモスの生肉
notes: Single boneless meat cut reconstructed from built-in imagegen reference through local TRELLIS-2.
Exact dense and reduced GLB front, rear, top, bottom and oblique views reviewed: closed surface, readable muscle and pale fat, no gross holes or normal artifacts.
141302 source triangles reduced to 2826 by measured QEM; source UV/albedo retained at 512px. Dielectric roughness 0.62.
Width 0.55m; rigid pickup requires no skeleton. Unreviewed experimental LODs retained in source workspace but not delivered.
